sources.title: GitHub - apple/ml-depth-pro: Depth Pro: Sharp Monocular Metric Depth in ...
sources.snippet: Our model, Depth Pro, synthesizes high-resolution depth maps with unparalleled sharpness and high-frequency details. The predictions are metric, with absolute scale, without relying on the availability of metadata such as camera intrinsics. And the model is fast, producing a 2.25-megapixel depth map in 0.3 seconds on a standard GPU.
